lines.en: I walk ahead. The line follows.

lines.zh: 我的脖子比这条路还长。
lines.en: My neck is longer than this road.
Four feet. One step at a time. Steady.
I step on grass, never on stones.
The load on my back does not shift.

lines.zh: 风从山坡下来，我迎着走。
lines.en: Wind comes off the hill. I walk into it.

lines.zh: 我走得慢，是不想让货掉。
lines.en: I walk slowly so nothing falls.

lines.zh: 前面有坡，我先上去看看。
lines.en: A slope ahead. I go up first.

lines.zh: 我的蹄子敲在土上，很轻。
lines.en: My hooves tap the dirt lightly.
In this caravan, I decide the pace.
I skirt around a clump of tall grass.
This path has the tenderest grass.

lines.zh: 我回头看一眼，确认没人掉队。
lines.en: I glance back to make sure no one strays.

lines.zh: 我的影子在草丛里一颠一颠。
lines.en: My shadow bobs through the grass.
I walk through a patch of flowering grass.
Going downhill, I hold my steps short.
I chew grass and think slowly.
The grass is a bit old. It will do.
I look up. The wind is turning.

lines.zh: 站着不动，也是一种本事。
lines.en: Standing still is also a skill.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵转向声音那边。
lines.en: My ears swivel toward the sound.
The blanket on my back is crooked.
I flick my tail at the flies.
I am tired of the grass on this slope.
I let out a loud snort.
I fix my eyes on a distant bird.
The sun warms my wool.
I chew my cud slowly. No rush.

lines.zh: 有人在我旁边坐下，我不介意。
lines.en: Someone sits beside me. I do not mind.

lines.zh: 我在等队伍收拾好东西。
lines.en: I wait for the caravan to pack up.
My wool is a little ragged today.
I hear a bell down the hill.
Is that hay in your hand?

lines.zh: 你站得太近了，我脖子长。
lines.en: You stand too close. My neck is long.

lines.zh: 我打量你，像在打量驮马。
lines.en: I size you up like a pack horse.
Have you seen the load on my back?
Nice hat. The grass is poor.
I do not follow just anyone.
Ask before you touch me.

lines.zh: 我看你像个走远路的人。
lines.en: You look like someone walking far.
I am squinting because I am tolerating you.
Do not reach so quickly.
I know the grass smell on you.
You are standing on my grass.
Lifting my chin is politeness.

lines.zh: 你说话轻一点，我耳朵灵。
lines.en: Speak softly. My ears are sharp.
Is that grass or rope in your hand?

lines.zh: 我往旁边挪了一步，别贴这么近。
lines.en: I shift a step sideways. Do not crowd me.
You kicked my ribs.
I do not cry out. I glare.

lines.zh: 疼，但我背上的货不放下。
lines.en: It hurts, but my cargo stays on.

lines.zh: 再打我就吐你一脸口水。
lines.en: Hit me again and I'll spit in your face.
This kick, I will remember for life.
I back away because it hurts.

lines.zh: 再拽缰绳我就吐你一脸。
lines.en: Pull that lead again and I will spit in your face.
The herd remembers grudges together.
You strike a beast carrying cargo?
I snort out a loud breath.
Hay. Hand it over. I will not be shy.

lines.zh: 这一把麦子，够我走一里。
lines.en: This handful of wheat is worth a mile.

lines.zh: 你晃干草的样子很可笑，但我吃。
lines.en: You wave hay foolishly, but I will eat.
I follow the hay, not you. Understand that.
A little more, and I will let you lead me.

lines.zh: 这草的香味，隔着坡都闻得到。
lines.en: I smell that hay from across the slope.
I lower my head. This is rare.

lines.zh: 干草捆在背上，饭在嘴里。
lines.en: Hay on my back, hay in my mouth.

lines.zh: 你给得爽快，我就走得爽快。
lines.en: Give freely, and I will walk freely.

lines.zh: 别拿草逗我，我脾气不好。
lines.en: Do not tease me with grass. I have a temper.
One bite. Just one, then we walk.

lines.zh: 这草比你说的好话实在。
lines.en: This hay is more honest than your flattery.

lines.zh: 我闻到麦香，就走不动了。
lines.en: I smell wheat and my legs stop.
Do not pull your hand back. I am not done.
I see that bundle of hay.
Walk ahead. I am following the hay.

lines.zh: 干草的味道比你的话管用。
lines.en: The smell of hay works better than your words.
One mouthful and you may touch my back.

lines.zh: 我脖子一伸，就到了你手边。
lines.en: My neck reaches your hand easily.

lines.zh: 你手里还有吗？我看着呢。
lines.en: Is there more in your hand? I am watching.
Do not crowd me. I am carrying a load.
Bump me and my cargo falls.
I stepped aside. Stop pushing.

lines.zh: 我的肩膀很硬，撞上会疼。
lines.en: My shoulder is hard. That will hurt.

lines.zh: 你踩到我背上的货箱了。
lines.en: You stepped on the crate on my back.
I step forward, and the path narrows.

lines.zh: 我脖子一低，正好挡住你。
lines.en: I lower my neck right in your way.
Make room. I turn awkwardly.
My wool rubs all over you.
Do not tug my blanket.

lines.zh: 我看上的是那头毛最厚的。
lines.en: I have my eye on the thickest-wooled one.

lines.zh: 想配我，先跟得上我的步子。
lines.en: To court me, keep up with my pace.

lines.zh: 我要找个能驮东西的伴。
lines.en: I want a mate who can carry.

lines.zh: 我们这一族，挑伴很讲究。
lines.en: Our kind is particular about partners.
The grey one keeps looking at me.

lines.zh: 别打扰，我们在互相打量。
lines.en: Do not interrupt. We are sizing each other up.

lines.zh: 我要让幼崽生在草好的地方。
lines.en: I want my young born where the grass is good.

lines.zh: 这种事，得先看谁能领头。
lines.en: For this, first see who can lead.

lines.zh: 我喷了他一脸，他还在跟。
lines.en: I spat at him, and he still follows.

lines.zh: 生下来的小家伙，腿真长。
lines.en: The little one has very long legs.
I lower my head and take a bundle of hay.
I will carry this hat for you.
Whatever is on the ground, I can carry.
I straighten the blanket with my teeth.
Put the sack of wheat on my back.

lines.zh: 我捡起一根掉落的缰绳。
lines.en: I pick up a dropped lead.
I cannot grip anything too small.
I sniff it. Worthless.
This cloth will do as padding.
I toss it onto my back. Steady.
You touched me a moment ago.

lines.zh: 我嘴里已经攒好一口唾沫。
lines.en: I already have a mouthful of spit ready.
I am about to spit in your face.
Do not think I only eat grass.
Back off and I will let it go.
My ears are already flattened.
You have annoyed me, human.
The whole herd is watching you.
My chin is up. That is a warning.
Take one more step. Try it.
I stare, neck stiff.
Do not make me spit at you.
My mouth is already loaded.
Have you backed off? Not yet.
I shuffle forward half a step.
My herd is closing in too.
I will not swallow this insult.
You had better not turn your back.
My hoof is scraping the dirt.
Here it comes. Move.
Ptooey. Right in the face.
This spit is my receipt.
I plant a hoof in your chest.
My spit stinks. I know.
Do not wipe. It will not come off.
I swing my head into you.
You stepped back three paces. Good.
I am not a docile pack animal.
That should teach you something.
Hmph. Winded already, are you?

lines.zh: 我从山坡的草里站起来。
lines.en: I rise from the grass on the slope.

lines.zh: 这片高原，风很大，草很甜。
lines.en: This plateau has strong wind and sweet grass.
I was born where the wind blows.

lines.zh: 我第一次站起，腿还在抖。
lines.en: My legs shook the first time I stood.
The grass beside me was taller than me.
The sun has just reached these hills.

lines.zh: 我们一出生就跟着母亲走。
lines.en: We walk with our mothers from birth.
This grassy slope is a fine place to stand.
I shook out my wool.

lines.zh: 风把我的耳朵吹得发凉。
lines.en: The wind chills my ears.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的毛，味道很难闻。
lines.en: Fire singed my wool. The smell is awful.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下去，货散了。
lines.en: I rolled down the slope and spilled my load.

lines.zh: 水漫上我的脖子，很不舒服。
lines.en: Water climbs my neck. Very unpleasant.

lines.zh: 爆炸的土块砸在我背上。
lines.en: Blast debris hit my back.

lines.zh: 箭扎进我的臀部，我跳起来。
lines.en: An arrow in my rump made me jump.

lines.zh: 魔法让我的腿软了一下。
lines.en: Magic made my legs buckle once.

lines.zh: 没草吃的时候，我脾气更差。
lines.en: With no grass, my temper worsens.

lines.zh: 雷劈在旁边的树上，我逃了。
lines.en: Lightning hit the tree beside me; I fled.
There is no grass below the void.
